_comment: Pre-existing color-budget violations. Routes listed here print a ⚠ warning in CI output but do NOT cause a non-zero exit — they are tracked, not silently ignored. Remove a route only once its violation is confirmed fixed. Each route must have a corresponding JBJ-### item in ROADMAP.md.
_provenance: All 7 routes confirmed against the CI runner (run 32120369539), which is the environment the gate actually runs in. The original PR #43 count of 7 was correct. An earlier revision of this file cut the list to 4 based on local runs where 3 of these routes timed out before their shell mounted and were therefore never measured — that was a property of the slower local sandbox, not of the routes. Values below are the CI measurements. Whether a lazy-loaded shell mounts inside SHELL_TIMEOUT_MS is machine-dependent, so the not-audited list can differ between environments; the run now prints that list explicitly (JBJ-036) instead of counting unmeasured routes as passes.
